programme.desc: A downtrodden handyman is forced to look after his niece and nephew. He soon wins them over with his knack for telling exciting stories, but to their surprise the tall tales start coming true - and as the children make their own suggestions, the results become even more incredible. Fantasy comedy, starring Adam Sandler, Keri Russell, Guy Pearce and Russell Brand

programme.title: Wish
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Asha makes a wish on a star to save her kingdom from rising evil and her plea is answered by a celestial body with the power to grant further desires. Animated fantasy featuring the voice of Arianna DeBose

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline

programme.title: Enter the Dragon
programme.desc: A powerful crime kingpin hosts a martial arts tournament on his island lair. A former Shaolin monk is recruited by an intelligence agency to enter the tournament and expose the crime lord's opium and slavery rings. He finds himself fighting for his life alongside two Vietnam veterans who are both fleeing their own enemies. Thriller, starring Bruce Lee, John Saxon, Jim Kelly and Kien Shih

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: A secret service operative is reassigned from Presidential Protection after a tragic accident. As he prepares to leave his assignment, terrorists take control of the White House and hold the president hostage. The agent is trapped in the building, and uses his inside knowledge to rescue the head of state. Action thriller, starring Gerard Butler, Aaron Eckhart and Morgan Freeman

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: A haunted special forces soldier returns to London from Afghanistan and assumes another man's identity, hoping to make a fresh start. He is drawn into the city's criminal underworld, where his skills prove valuable to the highest bidder, and plots revenge against the gangster who killed his girlfriend. Crime thriller, with Jason Statham and Agata Buzek

programme.title: The Legend of Tarzan
programme.desc: [AD] Economic unrest ensues after King Leopold cuts off access to the Belgian Congo, so years after leaving his old home behind, Tarzan is lured back from Victorian England hoping to stabilise matters. However, he soon finds he has been lured into a deadly trap orchestrated by one of Leopold's envoys. Adventure, starring Alexander Skarsgard, Margot Robbie and Samuel L Jackson

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: A teenager breaks the world record for a video game depicting spaceship battles, unaware the game is based on a real interplanetary war and has been created as a test to recruit fighter pilots. When a besieged planet's entire fleet is wiped out, he is forced to take on an entire alien armada single-handed. Sci-fi adventure, starring Lance Guest and Robert Preston

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: A palaeontologist, a game warden, a conspiracy theorist and a redneck sheriff each set out to investigate a mysterious death on the shore of a lake, only to find themselves up against a man-eating 30ft crocodile with an insatiable appetite. Comedy horror, starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda, Oliver Platt, Brendan Gleeson and Betty White

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: A teenager breaks the world record for a video game depicting spaceship battles, unaware the game is based on a real interplanetary war and has been created as a test to recruit fighter pilots. When a besieged planet's entire fleet is wiped out, he is forced to take on an entire alien armada single-handed. Sci-fi adventure, starring Lance Guest and Robert Preston

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: [AD] A streetwise cop is enlisted by a top-secret government force dedicated to policing alien visitors to Earth, teaming up with a veteran agent just as a body-swapping extraterrestrial giant insect begins a reign of terror throughout New York City. Sci-fi comedy, starring Will Smith, Tommy Lee Jones, Linda Fiorentino, Rip Torn and Vincent D'Onofrio

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Two teenage friends are on the brink of going to different colleges, so decide to mark the event by going to a party where they hope to lose their virginity. However, they have promised to supply the booze for the event, a task that proves much harder than expected because they are under age. Unfortunately, when a friend steps in to help, the situation gets even worse. Comedy, starring Jonah Hill, Michael Cera and Christopher Mintz-Plasse

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Jack, a struggling musician, gets hit by a bus during a mysterious event. When he regains consciousness, he finds that he is the only person who can remember the Beatles, and sets out to exploit the opportunity by passing their hits off as his own compositions. Comedy, with Himesh Patel and Lily James. Directed by Danny Boyle

programme.title: Finding Your Feet
programme.desc: A wealthy woman's privileged existence is shattered when she discovers her husband is having an affair with her best friend. Seeking solace, she turns to her estranged sister, who lives in a London council estate, and finds a new lease of life in joining her community dance class. Comedy, starring Imelda Staunton, Celia Imrie, Timothy Spall and Joanna Lumley

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: The place is Moscow, the year is 1953 and after being in power for nearly 30 years, Soviet dictator Joseph Stalin dies after an inconveniently brief illness. Amid the shock, the members of the Council of Ministers engage in a chaotic bid for power. Armando Iannucci's political satire, starring Andrea Riseborough, Jason Isaacs, Rupert Friend, Simon Russell Beale, Steve Buscemi, Jeffrey Tambor and Michael Palin

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: All the Devils Are Here
programme.desc: Secluded in the middle of Dartmoor, four thieves hide out with nothing to do but count the money and kill time. Thriller, starring Eddie Marsan, Sam Claflin and Burn Gorman

programme.title: Hallow Road
programme.desc: Two parents are thrust into a desperate race against time after a late-night call from their daughter reveals she caused a devastating car accident. Director Babak Anvari's psychological thriller, starring Rosamund Pike and Matthew Rhys

programme.title: King Ivory
programme.desc: Tulsa narcotics cop Layne West is locked in a battle with the city's criminal underworld. When his son becomes addicted to fentanyl, West teams up with his partner Ty and FBI agent Beatty to bring down those responsible. Thriller, starring James Badge Dale and Ben Foster

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Having lost her job and her husband, alcoholic Rachel Watson spends time aimlessly travelling on a train. She gets drawn into a web of intrigue when she becomes fascinated by a woman's disappearance. Rachel thinks she has vital evidence in cracking the case, but gaps in her memory cloud her judgment, and before long her own life is endangered. Thriller based on Paula Hawkins' novel, starring Emily Blunt, Rebecca Ferguson, Haley Bennett, Justin Theroux and Luke Evans

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: [AD] One-eyed, over-the-hill US Marshal Rooster Cogburn reluctantly agrees to help a girl track down her father's killer. The quest is complicated by a Texas Ranger, who is also on the murderer's trail, and a host of villains who have few qualms about disposing of the meddling youngster and her protector. Western, starring an Oscar-winning John Wayne alongside Jeff Corey, Kim Darby, Glen Campbell, Robert Duvall and Dennis Hopper

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Anthology of stories charting the romantic complications of various Los Angeles residents. A businessman and a soldier on leave share a flight home, a teacher is smitten with a doctor and an elderly couple comfort their lovesick grandson. Romantic comedy drama, with Ashton Kutcher, Jessica Alba, Jamie Foxx, Jennifer Garner and Julia Roberts

programme.title: Eleanor the Great
programme.desc: After a devastating loss, sharp-witted, defiant 94-year-old Eleanor Morgenstein tells a story that spirals into a dangerous reality. Director Scarlett Johansson's drama, starring June Squibb, Erin Kellyman and Chiwetel Ejiofor

programme.title: Tommy
programme.desc: A teenager is struck deaf, mute and blind by a childhood trauma. He finds self-expression through pinball, proving his worth by beating a master of the game. However, the pressures of fame take their toll on the youngster, who becomes the focus of a religious cult. Ken Russell's rock opera based on the Who's album, starring Roger Daltrey, Oliver Reed, Ann-Margret, Robert Powell, Jack Nicholson, Tina Turner and Keith Moon

programme.title: Bone Lake
programme.desc: A couple's holiday is upended when they're forced to share a mansion with a mysterious couple, spiralling into a maze of sex, lies and manipulation. Comedy thriller, starring Alex Roe and Maddie Hasson

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: [AD] A cocky test pilot is given a mysterious ring by a dying alien and transported to another world, where he learns he has been recruited into a galactic peacekeeping organisation. He trains to use the incredible powers the ring grants him, and returns to Earth to defend it from a powerful force that feeds on fear. Sci-fi adventure, starring Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard and Mark Strong

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: [AD] Massachusetts doctor Louis Creed moves to a small Maine town with his wife Rachel, their kids, Ellie and Gage, and Church, the cat. While exploring the local woods, Ellie stumbles across a funeral procession of children taking a dead dog to a cemetery. Neighbour Jud Crandall warns the Creeds that the woods are dangerous, as they soon discover for themselves via the dark power of the local burial ground. Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: In the near future, Australian cop Max Rockatansky tires of battling to impose law and order on the roads and turns in his badge - only to be forced out of retirement when his wife and child are murdered at the hands of a motorcycle gang. George Miller's action thriller, starring Mel Gibson, Joanne Samuel and Hugh Keays-Byrne

programme.title: Bugonia
programme.desc: Two conspiracy-obsessed men become convinced that the powerful CEO of a major corporation is actually an alien plotting the destruction of Earth. Acting on their bizarre theory, they kidnap her and set out to expose what they believe is an extra-terrestrial conspiracy. Director Yorgos Lanthimos's offbeat sci-fi comedy, starring an Oscar-nominated Emma Stone, with Jesse Plemons and Alicia Silverstone

programme.desc: A woman planning her wedding to a man she has only been dating for a few months asks her father to officiate. Festive romance, starring Madeleine Arthur, Robert Bazzocchi and Eric Close

programme.desc: Beau Ouimette and Rick Edwards head to the River Avon at the foot of one of Britain's most historic sites, Old Sarum near Salisbury. programme.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
programme.desc: Monty Don celebrates the rewards of winter gardening, sharing ideas, inspiration and timely jobs to keep gardeners busy now, while reminding viewers that warmer days lie ahead. At Longmeadow, he has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment, where there is always plenty to do during the colder months, including some clever composting.

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: [AD] Caleb panics as he realises someone saw his kiss with Sadie, while Nicola and Lewis try to resolve their work disputes and April and Dylan's relationship faces further strain

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: [AD] Lily, Jake, Hope and Ruby set off fireworks in the street, Ross advises Tyrone to show Fiz who's boss, and Brody feels guilty as the factory workers face a frugal Christmas

programme.title: George Clarke's Building Home
programme.desc: [AD] In Radcliffe-on-Trent, Nottinghamshire, ex Royal Marine Joel and salesperson Nicola take on the task of restoring Joel's grandparents Victorian cottage to its former glory. With the help of Joel's dad, a former brick-layer who's coming out of retirement for the build, the couple plan to add a two-storey extension into the middle of the house but with a stretched budget, a tight yuletide timeline and Joel being offered his dream job, things don't quite go to plan

programme.title: Inside the Bomb Squad: Zero Hour
programme.desc: Following some of the most elite units of the British Army and Royal Navy - the bomb disposal squads who face over 2,500 bomb emergencies each year. Kharn and Holly from Chester Troop bomb disposal are called to a recycling plant in Bolton, where a live grenade has been discovered on the sorting line. The item has been hit by machinery, making it extremely dangerous

programme.title: Whale with Steve Backshall
programme.desc: [AD] Steve returns home and travels around the British Isles to follow stories of survival and meet the people striving to give whales and dolphins a safe future

programme.title: Caught on Dashcam
programme.desc: Fly-on-the-dashboard documentary showcasing outrageous road disasters, captured in video form by drivers' in-vehicle dashboard cameras

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.sub-title: The Fall of the House of St Gardner
programme.desc: [AD] A gossip columnist is murdered after threatening to expose a fashion house's secrets, leaving the sleuthing priest with a fresh mystery to solve. Whodunit, starring Mark Williams

programme.title: The Good Life
programme.desc: [AD] Tom and Barbara get closer to nature than they intended when they catch fleas and struggle to keep them away from Margo and Jerry. Comedy, starring Richard Briers and Felicity Kendal

programme.title: Would I Lie to You?
programme.desc: Rob Brydon hosts the comedy panel show in which two teams of celebs try to call each other's bluff with a few stories about themselves that might be true or might be out-and-out porkies. Joining team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack are comedians Jo Brand, Roisin Conaty and Paul Foot, and TV wildlife presenter Ray Mears

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with Rachel's Phone Number
programme.desc: [AD] Chandler returns from Tulsa to visit Monica, but has to hide from Joey after rejecting his offer of free basketball tickets. Rachel goes out with Phoebe for a night on the town, while Ross and Mike find they have nothing in common

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with Christmas in Tulsa
programme.desc: [AD] Chandler feels glum at having to spend Christmas in Tulsa, so a workmate stays behind to keep him company. Unfortunately, she ends up making a pass at him, prompting him to take drastic action and quit his job altogether. Guest starring Selma Blair

programme.title: Resident Alien
programme.desc: [AD] Harry is brought in front of the Galactic Housing Council to answer for his crimes

programme.title: David Holmes: The Boy Who Lived
programme.sub-title: David Holmes: The Boy Who Lived
programme.desc: [AD] Documentary telling the story of Daniel Radcliffe's Harry Potter stunt double David Holmes, who was left paralysed from the chest down after an on-set accident in 2009. Featuring personal footage shot over the last decade, behind-the-scenes material from Holmes's stunt work, scenes of his current life and interviews with David as well as Daniel Radcliffe, friends, family and former crewmates

programme.title: TOTP: 1986
programme.desc: Janice Long and John Peel present the pop chart programme, first broadcast November 20, 1986. Featuring Europe, Simple Minds, Swing Out Sister, Erasure, Bon Jovi, Berlin and Red Box

programme.title: TOTP: 1989
programme.desc: Simon Mayo presents the pop chart programme, first broadcast on November 16, 1989 and featuring performances by 808 State, Lisa Stansfield, Inner City, UB40, Kaoma, Iron Maiden and Phil Collins

programme.title: Wheel of Fortune
programme.desc: [AD] Graham Norton hosts the game show as business strategist Mubeen, theatre technician Emma, and ambulance controller Paddy compete to solve word puzzles to get the chance to spin the wheel and win big money prizes, with a potential jackpot of £50,000

programme.title: Doc Martin
programme.desc: [AD] The doctor is surprised when his parents visit out of the blue, but they bring unwelcome tidings for all, especially Aunt Joan, who may be driven from her home. School secretary Maureen receives better news when what she thought was her thyroid problem turns out to be a pregnancy. Louisa calls Martin after Danny collapses - but the ambulance is delayed and emergency surgery must be performed to save his life

programme.title: Junk & Disorderly
programme.desc: Henry and Skid yet again venture out for more adventures and more automotive treasures. This time they pay a visit to H&H Auctions in Nottinghamshire

programme.title: World's Most Evil Killers
programme.desc: The story of Don Miller, a terrifying killer who snatched away the lives of four victims before being caught while trying to claim his fifth

programme.title: Guy Garvey: From the Vaults
programme.desc: The Elbow frontman introduces music from the TV archives from 1984, a year that saw Frankie Goes to Hollywood and Tom Robinson release war-themed songs and the Pogues make an early TV appearance

programme.title: Britain's Most Historic Towns
programme.desc: Professor Alice Roberts explores the story of Stewart Britain by visiting Stirling, the seat of the Scottish royal family for 200 years. She joins a team of archaeologists in uncovering remnants of the docks, explores the secret passageways of Stirling Castle, learns how to make medieval ale, and discovers the origins of football

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue
programme.desc: [AD] The rescue team tries to save an otter as Dr Marty battles rough conditions to help an entangled sea lion. At the Rescue Centre, a mischievous seal pup puts himself in danger

programme.title: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Parker buys a new plant to mine the promising Road Cut. Tony's crew runs bedrock to keep gold flowing. Greg and Buzz decode mysterious black paydirt.

programme.title: Teen Mom UK: From First Baby Steps
programme.desc: Mia makes a surprise return! Chloe rebels, Sassi struggles back at home and Megan faces her feelings. Shannon and Charlie go house-hunting while Amber sleeps on the streets

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ally babysits the twins, and does such a good job that Debra gives her even more responsibility around the house. However, Marie fears her granddaughter is being treated like a slave

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray worries Debra's criticism will make the children think he is a fool, and hatches a plan to win back their respect

programme.title: Casualty 24/7: Every Second Counts
programme.desc: Documentary following the work of medical emergency teams in the A&E department of Barnsley Hospital. Paramedics rush in Dean, a 30-year-old who has been admitted after being in a serious motorbike collision and may have spinal injuries. Elsewhere, doctors treat a 20-year-old with severe abdominal pain, and a 90-year-old with an injured finger

programme.title: Megastorm
programme.desc: [AD] Wildfires are part of life in Australia, but in the summer of 2019 the country was drier and hotter than ever. In what becomes known as the Black Summer, 24 million hectares burned. Stories from this disastrous summer include firefighters taking on a new species of fire, a woman battling to save her home, and the Royal Australian Navy carrying out an unprecedented evacuation

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: [AD] Bradley Walsh presents as contestants Aaron, Anne, Susan and Joe pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught

programme.title: Lingo
programme.desc: Coming up against the reigning champions are married couple Alice and Richard and Sophie and her niece Kristina. Word game, hosted by Adil Ray

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance: Coast and Country
programme.desc: [AD] Crews require support from the fire brigade to rescue a woman stuck inside her locked house. Plus, they help a child with a dangerously high temperature

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: [AD] When the guys are unable to get tickets for Comic-Con, Leonard, Howard and Raj decide to buy fake passes from a stranger - but they then worry about getting caught with them. Sheldon decides to hold his own comic-book convention and searches for a suitable star guest for the event. Meanwhile, the girls take tea at a hotel but discover that maturity is over-rated. Comedy, guest starring James Earl Jones and Carrie Fisher

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: [AD] Sheldon and Amy take a train ride to the Napa Valley with Howard and Bernadette on Valentine's Day, while Leonard and Penny head to the vets when they volunteer to look after Raj's dog. Comedy, starring Johnny Galecki, Jim Parsons and Kaley Cuoco

programme.title: Dim Cwsg i Quinnell
programme.desc: [AD] Scott Quinnell helps with milking on a farm near Bridgend, and makes whiskey at AberFalls Distillery in Abergwyngregyn, near Bangor.

programme.title: Stiwdio 24/7
programme.desc: Presenter Molly Palmer introduces some of the best bands and artists from the current Welsh rock and pop scene

programme.title: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd
programme.desc: S4C News & Weather

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Uncle Phil summons Will and Hilary to the witness box in a court case with a difference. American comedy, starring Will Smith, James Avery and Alfonso Ribeiro

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will and Carlton suspect one of their neighbours is at fault when the family silver disappears during a party. Zsa Zsa Gabor guest stars

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay heads to the Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, where he meets a stubborn owner who doesn't react well to criticism. Tom bought the restaurant for his daughter Andrea, but six years later he's still refusing to let her run it. Can the chef break Tom's iron grip on the business and persuade him to change his outdated approach?

programme.title: Green Eyed Killers
programme.desc: Just days after Hollie Gazzard had attempted to end her relationship with Asher Maslin, her life was cut tragically short as the jealous ex attacked

programme.title: Celebrity Yorkshire Auction House
programme.desc: Actress Helen Flanagan wants to sell some Corrie keepsakes and haute couture, while comedian Bobby Davro brings coins and sporting memorabilia.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: [AD] The team works with Abigail Borin of the Coast Guard Investigative Service after a highly suspicious explosion and fire on board an oil rig kills a US marine corps reservist. Abby detects malware in the platform's computer systems, while Ducky finds traces on the victim's body that lead to a lawyer who works for the oil company. Back in the office, a prankster is bringing some light relief and although the likeliest suspect is Tony, he denies any involvement. Crime drama, guest starring Diane Neal

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Izzie Balmer and James Braxton tour Izzie's native Derbyshire on the final leg, where she tempts the gourmand with some local delicacies. There's a blast from the past as James is carried away by the news from the 1780s while Izzie follows in the tracks of Winston Churchill. Then, it's onwards to auction in Lincoln

programme.title: Miss Marple: They Do It with Mirrors
programme.desc: [AD] Feature-length episode of the mystery drama. The sleuthing senior citizen is urged by an old friend to visit her sister as she is convinced something is wrong. Miss Marple heads for the country to investigate and it is not long before a heated argument in a locked room ends with a gunshot that leaves a man dead. Feature-length episode of the mystery drama, starring Joan Hickson, with Jean Simmons and Joss Ackland. First broadcast in 1991

programme.title: Christmas at River Cottage
programme.desc: Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall challenges his two chefs to create a new recipe using Brussels sprouts, and a butcher shows how to find the most tender cuts in the forequarter of a cow. The cook also goes hunting for sika deer, to be used in a venison roast, and creates a flaming jam roly-poly using the fat from a cow's kidney

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Sheppard and Teyla watch in awe as the Wraith pass overhead, but are powerless to prevent an attack. The Atlantis crew members are given a brief opportunity to send video messages to their loved ones back on Earth, but do not know whether the transmissions will arrive successfully

programme.title: UK Crime Files: Murder-Three Little Kisses
programme.desc: Christopher and Amanda Birks appeared to have a happy family life. When their house caught fire, Christopher and the children escaped, but Amanda didn't.

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: Real-life small-claims cases on issues affecting family life, presided over by outspoken former New York judge Judy Sheindlin

programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.title: Walker, Texas Ranger
programme.desc: Part two of two. Walker must summon the courage to tell seven-year-old Lucas he has contracted Aids from his mother. Chuck Norris stars

programme.title: Murder on CCTV
programme.desc: In 2015 Tierra Hall says goodbye to her mother for the last time. 24 hours later, the teenager's dead body turns up outside an abandoned house

programme.title: All Creatures Great and Small

Farmer Dakin is very attached to his injured, elderly cow, but Siegfried advises letting the animal go, while James and Helen arrive at a long-awaited decision

programme.title: Hawaii Five-0
programme.desc: The detectives assume local thugs are to blame when the body of a businessman is found beaten and shot to death in the boot of a car. Meanwhile, McGarrett calls on old friend Mike Logan to run surveillance on his mother - but instead of keeping tabs on her from afar, the agent ends up taking Doris on a date. Treat Williams (Everwood) guest stars

programme.desc: Inspector Anton Sullivan pulls over a driver on the M6 who has a rubber boat unsecurely tied to the roof of his car. programme.title: Murder in the Heartland
programme.desc: [AD] The hunt for the killer of a person whose body was found on the banks of the river in Dunlap, Tennessee. Detectives pieced together the unknown man's final moments to find the culprit

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: On the last leg of his journey across the North and the Midlands, Robbie faces issues with ice on the Grand Union Canal. programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie Cumming explores life on the English canal network. A low canal tunnel in Staffordshire proves to be problematic and Robbie helps out a stranded boater

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal

programme.title: Titanic: A Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: As the Titanic started to sink in April 1912, another ship came into view, offering her passengers the hope of being rescued. However, despite a fusillade of rockets, the ship turned away. Within two hours, 1,500 people were dead. An American investigation at the time accused the SS Californian, even though the freighter was stationary that night. A British inquiry concurred, keen to shift blame from national failures on lifeboat provision and steamship supervision. However, since Titanic's wreck was discovered, the mystery began to unlock, and now, with recently discovered clues, a new suspect has emerged: the SS Mount Temple. This documentary follows a range of experts, using the latest investigative tools, as they examine these new clues and revisit the evidence from 1912 to take a fresh look at the cold case of the 20th century

Damon Beesley and Iain Morris's blockbusting comedy sequel spun off from the hit sitcom, starring Simon Bird, James Buckley, Joe Thomas and Blake Harrison

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: A desperate farmer takes hostages to save his herd of cattle from being shot after four of them are diagnosed with tuberculosis. This draws Antoine into a tense rural standoff driven by fear, pride and family strain. Meanwhile, Manon and Hélène's son, Hadrien, are becoming attached. In French

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: [AD] A construction worker pays to have fake memories of a dream holiday to Mars implanted into his brain, but discovers his mind has already been tampered with - apparently to erase his true identity as a secret agent from a colony on the Red Planet. He journeys there in search of the truth, but is drawn into a conflict between the tyrannical ruler and a rebel faction. Paul Verhoeven's sci-fi thriller, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Rachel Ticotin, Ronny Cox and Michael Ironside

programme.title: Court Cam
programme.desc: A man attacks his neighbour, then faces jail time. A defendant ordered to turn himself in makes a run for it

Sci-fi thriller, starring Amber Midthunder and Dakota Beavers. Directed by Dan Trachtenberg, who also helmed recent franchise offerings Predator: Killer of Killers, and Predator: Badlands

Her Czech opponent has a respectable record of 12 wins, two draws and just one defeat, but it would be a major upset should she take Price's belts this evening

programme.title: Autumnwatch: Autumn Calm

programme.desc: A round-up of today's headlines

programme.title: BBC London News; Weather
programme.desc: The latest updates from the region

With music from Take That, performing their current single, Higher

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
programme.desc: A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents

programme.desc: The nomadic vigilante tries to save an army major who has been framed for murder and treason. Jack Reacher discovers that Turner has been targeted by a secret government conspiracy, and together they go on the run to expose the truth. Director Edward Zwick's blockbusting action thriller sequel based on Lee Child's novel, starring Tom Cruise, Cobie Smulders, Danika Yarosh and Aldis Hodge

programme.desc: Adam Hills, Josh Widdicombe and Alex Brooker are joined by celebrity guests for a comic review of the significant moments of the past seven days. As usual, the hashtag #isitok paves the way for the gang to round up, examine and explain the leading and most entertaining news stories of the week

programme.title: Back
programme.desc: Now he has a stake in the family business, Andrew decides to make drastic changes to the John Barleycorn pub in order to try and bring in a younger crowd. But Stephen is furious with Andrew's meddling, and insists that the pub does not need improvements. However, as the five-star reviews for the newly refurbished Barleycorn start rolling in, Stephen begins to feel suspicious of Andrew's actions

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: [AD] Frank tries to get over the grief of his best friend's death by attempting to aid his jailed daughter, Tess Ross

programme.title: The Gilded Age
programme.desc: [AD] Ada, Marian, and Aurora try to shield Agnes from the Ladies Home Journal article, while Bertha sets her sights on the presidential dinner

programme.title: Annika
programme.desc: [AD] The MHU are sent to Edinburgh to investigate the death of a recently released prisoner whose body is pulled out of the Forth River, imprisoned in a dog cage

Starring Steve Coogan and Felicity Montagu

programme.title: Have I Got a Bit More News for You
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade hosts an extended episode of the satirical quiz, with guest panellists Jack Dee and Kelly Cates joining team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop

programme.title: Jack Whitehall Live
programme.desc: The London-born comedian and actor in a stand-up performance, quickly flitting from one story to another as he effortlessly extracts the humour from every situation

programme.title: New Zealand Spy
programme.desc: Sue throws in the towel, while Michael sets out to save Anderson, in the process finding himself at the centre of a betrayal that leads him to his target, although not in the way he had hoped

programme.title: New Zealand Spy
programme.desc: Michael, Sue and Anderson chase Dennis Greene to stop his plan and save New Zealand from the Australians

programme.title: Becoming Madonna
programme.desc: [AD] Documentary charting the singer's rise to stardom, built around a cache of recently uncovered audio tapes in which a young Madonna reflects on her extraordinary life and career. Plus, rare footage, unseen photos and interviews with family, friends and collaborators

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: [AD] As Christmas descends on the Brown household, Agnes is intrigued by the arrival of a large box for Cathy - and even more puzzled when it turns out she's the only one in the family who doesn't know what's inside. The concerned mum also isn't happy at the news that Rory is having plastic surgery, especially when she gets the wrong end of the stick about what sort of nips and tucks he'll be having. Bad news for Winnie prompts her to make a life-changing announcement, which could spell the end of her lifelong friendship with Agnes, while Buster Brady delivers a new Christmas tree - and true to form, it refuses to cooperate. Brendan O'Carroll stars

programme.title: Jeff Buckley: Everybody Here Wants You
programme.sub-title: Jeff Buckley: Everybody Here Wants You
programme.desc: Documentary tribute to the singer-songwriter who died in a drowning accident in May 1997, aged 30. Although he had only one album under his belt, he was considered by many to be one of the best singers to emerge in recent years, before his death sealed his status as a doomed romantic hero. Interviews with Brad Pitt, Jimmy Page and Chrissie Hynde highlight how much the gifted musician is missed

programme.title: I'm a Celebrity... Unpacked
programme.desc: Sam Thompson and Kemi Rodgers host the companion show, featuring behind-the-scenes gossip, unseen clips, interviews and an insider guide to the trials

programme.title: Foyle's War
programme.desc: [AD] Foyle responds to complaints of sabotage at an RAF burns hospital and uncovers adultery and murder within the medical unit. As the hunt for the guilty party intensifies, the detective discovers his son Andrew could be a suspect and is shocked when he hears he has been reported missing from his barracks. Wartime crime drama, starring Michael Kitchen, John Wood, Honeysuckle Weeks and Julian Ovenden

programme.title: FYI Daily
programme.desc: Latest news from the world of entertainment.

programme.title: Killer Elite
programme.desc: A former secret agent comes out of retirement when his mentor is captured by an Arab leader. The hostage will be freed if the ex-spy kills three fellow operatives in punishment for murders they committed. However, a shadowy society of assassins intends to protect his targets and keep their past crimes a secret. Action thriller, with Jason Statham, Clive Owen and Robert De Niro

programme.title: Crime Scene Raw
programme.desc: After Marique Ruth claims she shot boyfriend John Killen in self-defence, forensic evidence and chilling bodycam footage cast doubt on her story

programme.title: Greatest Guitar Riffs
programme.desc: [AD] Andy Summers of the Police discusses his favourite ever riffs and discusses the ones that brought fame and fortune to his band in songs including Message in a Bottle, Roxanne, Don't Stand So Close to Me and Every Breath You Take

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: A look at the ancient Hindu Vedas, thousands of years old, which describe gods who traveled in flying machines and wielded extraordinary technology on Earth

programme.title: Europe's Amazon
programme.desc: Diving into the great floodplains that lie along the Drava River, areas that are at risk of intense seasonal flooding, before exploring the wetlands of Kopacki Rit

programme.title: Expedition Unknown
programme.desc: For the 40th Anniversary of The Goonies, Josh Gates braves the Oregon coast to search for the real-life pirate treasure that inspired his favourite movie.

programme.title: Rambo
programme.desc: The bandana-wearing one-man army has turned his back on violence to live a quiet life in Thailand. But before long he takes up arms once again to rescue a party of missionaries who have been taken captive en route to Burma by a sadistic military officer. Action sequel, directed by and starring Sylvester Stallone. With Julie Benz and Graham McTavish

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with the Red Sweater
programme.desc: [AD] Joey becomes convinced Phoebe is pregnant and proposes to her so she will not have to be a single mother - but Monica quickly tells him the truth. Meanwhile, Chandler and Ross misplace the disposable cameras used during the wedding

programme.title: Friends
programme.desc: [AD] Rachel reveals the identity of the father of her baby, while Chandler and Monica go on their honeymoon, but are constantly upstaged by another couple who get preferential treatment wherever they go

programme.title: A&E After Dark
programme.desc: A young woman is rushed to A&E in Belfast when she's found in the street having a serious reaction to a party drug. In Norwich, a motorcyclist is showing worrying signs of brain damage

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Investigators examine the Netherlands' worst ever aviation disaster, in which a plane crashed into an apartment complex, and discover a lethal problem with every 747 in the sky

programme.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
programme.desc: Colin Jackson, Anne Diamond, Josie Long and Nicky Campbell answer general knowledge questions and work as a team to take on all five of the ruthless Chasers and secure a charity prize. Anne Hegerty, Mark Labbett, Jenny Ryan, Paul Sinha and Shaun Wallace have donned their glam rags for the show, but will the celebs outshine the Chasers? Bradley Walsh presents

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Host Ben Shephard returns to pit four players against a mesmerising machine. There are mystery prizes and a jackpot up for grabs for any player with the skill and strategy to see off their human rivals and conquer the machine

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: Dispatchers Karen and Lucy face an overwhelming surge of urgent calls, while crews out on the road grow frustrated by frequent callers taking up valuable emergency resources. As call handlers answer a new 999 emergency every 12 seconds, the hoax caller from earlier in the shift returns. They make false reports, leading senior management to consider the extreme step of blocking their number. Narrated by Christopher Eccleston

programme.title: Bar Hansh
programme.desc: A surprise at the bar shakes things up as the group prepare for their next event. But as the competition heats up, so does the threat of the sack. The reps also discover what everyone really thinks of each other, causing tensions to rise

programme.title: Bar Hansh
programme.desc: Six young people run a Welsh bar in Zante, while competing for a cash prize of up to £10,000. The reps prepare for the final challenge

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: [AD] Brian, 74, is brought into King's by ambulance after falling backwards down a flight of stairs and being knocked unconscious at his partner's house. Sylvester arrives in paediatric A&E with his two-year-old son, who has cut his forehead on a visit to church, while 70-year-old builder Leonard has lost sensation down his left side and the medics are worried he may have suffered a stroke

programme.title: 999: On the Front Line
programme.desc: The emergency documentary follows the South Western Ambulance Service, which comprises nine crews working out of stations in Bristol, Bridgwater and Taunton. The paramedics treat a man with severe abdominal pains, who is reluctant to be taken to hospital, and a 95-year-old man who has fallen and injured his face. Meanwhile, two paramedics are forced to call for help when a patient lashes out at them

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, with Sean Lock and Roisin Conaty taking on guest captain Alan Carr and Joe Lycett. Susie Dent is joined by Spencer Jones in Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters

programme.title: My Strange Arrest
programme.desc: Strange arrests unfold, from an off-duty pilot allegedly trying to shut down a plane's engine to a delivery driver facing a bizarre accusation

programme.title: My Strange Arrest
programme.desc: Strange arrests include a golf cart on an airport walkway, half-naked fraternity pledges and a 70-year-old driving a Cybertruck into a lake

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The team revive a rusty chrome calendar ornament. They restore a 1930s schoolbook from Trinidad and a sweet little wind instrument called an ocarina

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: JT and Tess do all they can to keep a worried Cat focused on her imminent marriage to Vincent, while their own relationship flounders. Drama, starring Kristin Kreuk and Jay Ryan

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Dr Ebonie sees a patient whose feet are covered in wart-like masses, while Dr Brad treats a dangerous mystery case that could be related to Proteus syndrome

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: [AD] A body is found, prompting two people to confess to murder. When tests show the corpse is more than 600 years old, the team must discover why the pair took responsibility for a crime they could not possibly have committed and if they are in fact the perpetrators of other killings. Alun Armstrong and James Bolam star

programme.title: Gok Wan's Easy Asian Christmas
programme.desc: Gok shares his best recipes for a fabulous Christmas Day feast. Dishes include indulgent French toast with an Asian twist, and belly pork with honey and soy sauce

programme.title: New Scotland Yard Files
programme.desc: When dismembered body parts were found in bins on a residential street in Camden, London, detectives had to investigate quickly before the killer could strike again

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: A man entrusts his '69 Buick LeSabre to an auto mechanic for body work but claims the car was completely ruined.

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: A woman sues a man for breach of contract regarding the breeding of their French bulldogs after she is allegedly denied the proper pick of the litter.

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: A trucking company owner sues his former employee for a truck recovery fee after a breakdown, lost income and stolen property.

programme.title: Game Day Murders
programme.desc: [AD] When St. Louis Blues player Mike Danton faces arrest for a murder-for hire plot, it sends shockwaves through the NHL

programme.desc: Burke and the team investigate the murder of a scientific researcher involved in cloning experiments, and initially suspect a protest group is to blame. Drama, starring Blythe Duff, Alex Norton, John Michie, Colin McCredie and Tamara Kennedy

programme.title: Lone Survivor
programme.desc: Four American soldiers are sent on a mission into the mountains of Afghanistan to track down and eliminate a high-ranking terrorist leader. Fact-based drama, starring Mark Wahlberg, Taylor Kitsch, Emile Hirsch and Ben Foster

programme.desc: Throughout history, powerful nations have enlisted spies to serve as unique tools of warfare, infiltrating organizations and even performing the act of assassination

programme.title: Titanic: A Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: As the Titanic started to sink in April 1912, another ship came into view, offering her passengers the hope of being rescued. However, despite a fusillade of rockets, the ship turned away. Within two hours, 1,500 people were dead. An American investigation at the time accused the SS Californian, even though the freighter was stationary that night. A British inquiry concurred, keen to shift blame from national failures on lifeboat provision and steamship supervision. However, since Titanic's wreck was discovered, the mystery began to unlock, and now, with recently discovered clues, a new suspect has emerged: the SS Mount Temple. programme.title: Titanic: A Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: As the Titanic started to sink in April 1912, another ship came into view, offering her passengers the hope of being rescued. However, despite a fusillade of rockets, the ship turned away. Within two hours, 1,500 people were dead. An American investigation at the time accused the SS Californian, even though the freighter was stationary that night. A British inquiry concurred, keen to shift blame from national failures on lifeboat provision and steamship supervision. programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Jean Johansson meets Julie and Amanda, who have holidayed in France many times and love the countryside, the culture and the weather. With their teenage children heading to university, they want to find a holiday home where they can unwind and relax, and maybe make a permanent move to in the future. They've settled on Lot-et-Garonne, with its gorgeous countryside punctuated by beautiful villages and medieval towns, and 120 miles of waterways. Jean lines up five options for their budget of £120,000, from a riverside townhouse to a characterful stone house with land aplenty

programme.title: A Place in the Sun

With analysis from Bryan Habana and David Flatman, pitchside inserts by Claire Thomas and Brian O'Driscoll, and commentary from Miles Harrison and Gordon D'Arcy

programme.desc: [AD] Katniss Everdeen is brought to a secretive underground society following the destruction of the televised deathmatch. programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: [AD] The civilisation of Panem is consumed by a bloody civil war. Reluctant rebel leader Katniss Everdeen leads a band of her allies on a mission to end the conflict at one stroke by assassinating the despotic President Snow - but faces many dangers as she closes in on her target. Conclusion of the sci-fi adventure series based on Suzanne Collins' novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman in his final role

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: [AD] Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. programme.title: Shrek 2
programme.desc: The grouchy ogre and his new wife Princess Fiona set out on a journey to meet her parents. However, the king and queen are less than impressed with their daughter's choice of husband, while a conniving fairy godmother is determined to make sure her own son gets to marry the princess. Animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Mike Myers, Cameron Diaz, Eddie Murphy, Antonio Banderas, John Cleese, Julie Andrews, Jennifer Saunders and Rupert Everett

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Joining a spaceship crew, he embarks on a perilous journey in search of the loot - unaware that the vessel's cyborg cook is planning a mutiny. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson

programme.title: Planes
programme.desc: A crop duster longs to be a racing plane, but is hamstrung by a fear of heights. With the aid of a veteran flyer, he learns to conquer his phobia and compete against some of the world's greatest flyers in a round-the-world race. Animated adventure spin-off from Pixar's Cars, with the voices of Dane Cook, Teri Hatcher and Stacy Keach

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: A crook double-crosses his partners in crime, a betrayal that leaves their friend and mentor dead. One year later, they regroup and come up with a daring plan to exact revenge on the traitor and reclaim their ill-gotten gains. Crime thriller inspired by the 1969 movie, starring Mark Wahlberg, Charlize Theron, Edward Norton, Seth Green and Donald Sutherland

programme.title: Snakes on a Plane
programme.desc: An FBI agent is assigned to protect a witness in the trial of a feared crime boss. However, when they board their flight from Hawaii to Los Angeles, the gangster's henchmen set in motion their plan to smuggle onto the aircraft and then release 450 poisonous snakes. Thriller, starring Samuel L Jackson, Julianna Margulies and Jonathan Phillips

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: The arrival of secretive neighbours sparks an unhealthy curiosity in a group of friends, leading them to go to bizarre lengths to discover the truth about the newcomers. However, their investigations take an even weirder twist when they begin to suspect their unseen fellow suburbanites are part of a cannibalistic cult. Joe Dante's black comedy, starring Tom Hanks, Bruce Dern, Carrie Fisher, Corey Feldman and Henry Gibson

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: [AD] An eccentric but brilliant former cop sets himself up to champion the underdog - as a private eye specialising in locating missing animals. The zany detective is called in to find a kidnapped dolphin - the mascot of an American football team - and uncovers a plot involving high-level police corruption. Comedy, starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox, Sean Young, Tone Loc and Noble Willingham

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: The eccentric pet detective is coaxed out of self-imposed exile in a Buddhist monastery to visit Africa and help search for a sacred white bat. However, his unique investigative talents are tested to the limits as he faces a race against time to find the missing creature and prevent a tribal war. Comedy sequel, starring Jim Carrey, Simon Callow and Bob Gunton

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Jack, a struggling musician, gets hit by a bus during a mysterious event. When he regains consciousness, he finds that he is the only person who can remember the Beatles, and sets out to exploit the opportunity by passing their hits off as his own compositions. Comedy, with Himesh Patel and Lily James. Directed by Danny Boyle

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: [AD] A Soviet submarine commander creates an international crisis by piloting his experimental nuclear vessel, which is invisible to sonar, toward the American coast. The US and Russian navies think he is planning to attack and set out to destroy the submarine, but a CIA analyst suspects he intends to defect to the West. Cold War thriller, based on Tom Clancy's novel, starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and James Earl Jones

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: In 1971, an American military analyst uncovers the depths of the US government's deceptions about the futility of the Vietnam War, and takes action by copying top-secret documents that would become the Pentagon Papers. Washington Post owner Kay Graham and her editor Ben Bradlee discover The New York Times is preparing an explosive expose on those papers and, determined to compete, set out to publish them first. Steven Spielberg's fact-based drama, starring Meryl Streep, Tom Hanks, Sarah Paulson and Bob Odenkirk

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: [AD] Rebellious American teenager Danny falls for innocent Australian girl Sandy during the summer holidays, but when he later finds out she is a new student at his school, he risks losing her love by trying to act cool in front of his friends. Romantic musical set in the 1950s, starring John Travolta, Olivia Newton-John, Stockard Channing, Jeff Conaway, Didi Conn and Sid Caesar

programme.desc: [AD] The wildlife found in the polar oceans, from a bowhead whale breaking the sea ice with its skull to breathe to giant sea spiders clamber over ancient glass sponges. On the very first night, Liz hears footsteps on the landing. Fact-based supernatural drama, starring Gabrielle Creevy and Michael Socha

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: [AD] Eva takes a boat trip down the Seine with chef Eric Ripert and writer Lindsay Shapiro to explore the story of French gastronomy through a seven-course fine-dining meal. programme.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve

He also learns more about Oliver Cromwell's influence on Ireland, attends the Gaze film festival, and meets monkeys at an animal sanctuary in the Wicklow mountains

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing

They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of a rowing boat. Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey, but Bob has a supposedly foolproof method to try

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Edith Bowman and Colin Murray explore the Nairn Show to find tips and treats among the food stalls, including how to spot the perfect egg and how to choose the juiciest berries. Baker Briony-May Williams discovers bargains when using an app designed to reduce food waste, farmer Meinir Howells gets to grips with turning rapeseed into oil in Rhuthin, and chef Suzie Lee finds out whether there's such a thing as a healthy bacon sandwich.

programme.title: Autumnwatch: Autumn Calm
programme.desc: A welcome return for an audience favourite - Autumnwatch's Mindfulness Moments. This is an opportunity to switch off from the stresses of our busy lives and immerse ourselves in pure nature. No music, no presenter voice-over, just natural sound and glorious pictures to take us to the most stunning places in this most colourful of seasons

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Sonali Shah helps Norman and Linda swap London for a breath of fresh sea air in Dorset - and the line-up of properties includes a mystery house that die-hard fans of the show might just recognise. Sonali also takes a break from house hunting to unwind at a rejuvenating seaweed spa

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: [AD] Dominic Chinea and Will Kirk travel to Swindon where a local woodworking group need help repairing an aeroplane-shaped bench that pays tribute to the town's aviation history. Dom meets Tulsi, who brings with her a Hindu holy scripture passed down from her grandmother that's so fragile it can't be opened without further damage being caused and Will learns how to make traditional willow beehives

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: [AD] Michael Portillo heads from Newcastle to Lynemouth, and is intrigued to hear of its part in Newcastle's early industrial development. En route, Michael travels through the huge Northumberland coalfield and, at Cramlington, he alights to visit an extraordinary work of landform art made from the spoil of a coalmine, the vast Northumberlandia, known as the Lady of the North

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: [AD] Liz explores the natural wonders of the region and its remarkable ecosystems, encountering its wildlife and meeting inspiring local conservationists. She begins in the Greater Antilles, where people are learning to forge a new relationship with the animals that inhabit this wild terrain. On the island of Hispaniola in the Dominican Republic, she helps residents of the tiny village of Los Limones scale a 60ft palm tree to retrieve a Ridgeway's hawk chick at risk of a deadly parasitic infection

programme.title: Lingo
programme.desc: Quiz hosted by Adil Ray, with sisters Sangeeta and Namita from Bolton, mother and son Gill and Matt from Liverpool, and punctuation purist Priya and fiancé Priyesh from London. They use their powers of deduction to work out words that appear in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords. The last remaining duo have the opportunity to win the money they've banked earlier in the show to potentially double their winnings, or leave with nothing

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Jasmine Harman travels to Portugal's western Algarve to help Leslie and Clive from Wiltshire find the perfect property so that they can split their time between Portugal and the UK once they retire. Jasmine shows them five properties within their budget of £190,000. Are any of them Leslie and Clive's dream home?

programme.title: Operation Nutcracker
programme.desc: When an antique nutcracker goes missing from the Warby family Christmas charity auction, a demanding event planner and the heir to the Warby dynasty try to track it down. Adventurous festive romance starring Ashley Newbrough and Christopher Russell

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: [AD] When a shooting rocks a Los Angeles nightclub, the squad is thrust into the dark world of sex-trafficking and goes head-to-head with a biker gang

programme.title: Caught on Dashcam
programme.desc: A countdown of the most spectacular crashes caught on camera, from mega wipeouts to parking wars, animal chaos and two-wheeled smashes

programme.title: Billions
programme.desc: [AD] As the drama continues, a member of Axe's inner circle turns into an informant. Starring Paul Giamatti and Damian Lewis

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: While honeymooning in England, Crabtree and Effie find a hotel guest's death suspicious

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Hyacinth forces Richard to participate in a trip to the countryside to look for Iron Age remains, but further cultural excursions are curtailed when Daisy and Onslow report that Rose is behaving in an outrageous fashion. Comedy, starring Patricia Routledge

programme.title: Last of the Summer Wine
programme.sub-title: Here We Go into the Wild Blue Yonder
programme.desc: Part one of two. Compo yearns to reach for the skies in a hang-glider to impress Nora Batty, but finds a challenge to climb a tree more than enough to handle. Meanwhile, the object of his affections pesters Wally to take her out for a meal. Long-running comedy set in rural Yorkshire, starring Bill Owen and Kathy Staff

programme.title: Speed with Guy Martin
programme.desc: The racing fan sets out to break the record for the world's fastest gravity-powered sled, taking expert advice from Winter Olympic gold medallist Amy Williams. Guy experiences his first taste of going blisteringly fast on ice at the famous Cresta Run in the Swiss ski resort of St Moritz, before a crack team of engineers helps him build a prototype toboggan. Then it's on to Andorra in the Pyrenees, where he hopes to steer himself into the record books on the new speed ski slope Pista Riberal

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with the Boob Job
programme.desc: [AD] Cash-strapped couple Chandler and Monica conceal from each other that they have asked Joey for money. Rachel goes overboard in a bid to make her home baby-friendly, while Phoebe asks Mike to move in with her, but has second thoughts once it becomes clear he does not share her enthusiasm for marriage

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with the Memorial Service
programme.desc: [AD] A joke entry on Ross's college website backfires on Chandler. Joey refuses to give Emma his favourite stuffed toy, and weak-willed Phoebe begs Monica to help her avoid contacting Mike. Comedy, starring Matthew Perry and Matt LeBlanc

programme.title: Will & Grace
programme.desc: [AD] Karen returns from the Caribbean and persuades Rosario to take responsibility for the expensive contraband she is carrying. Meanwhile, Will is shocked to discover Jack has ingratiated himself with Grace in his absence. Starring Debra Messing and Eric McCormack

programme.title: Will & Grace
programme.desc: [AD] Karen continues to fume over the divorce, while Grace decides to move in with Will and Jack - but their apartment is too small, so one of them has to go. Comedy, starring Eric McCormack and Debra Messing

programme.title: My Icon: Heather Watson
programme.desc: [AD] British tennis star Heather Watson discusses the individuals who have inspired her over the course of her life

programme.title: The Only Way Is Essex
programme.desc: In Vietnam, Liv has doubts about her friendship with Elma. Back in Essex, Sophie and Jordan take the next steps towards parenthood, and Saff is more confused than ever.

programme.title: Classic Emmerdale
programme.desc: [AD] Val pleads for forgiveness from Pollard, Lexi accepts an offer of financial help from Scarlett to pursue her baby dream, and Edna resolves to put a stop to Lily's travel plans.

programme.title: The Prisoner
programme.desc: Number Six breaks out of the Village and returns to London, where he tries to convince his former employees his ordeal was not a figment of his imagination

programme.title: Killer in My Village
programme.desc: The story of artist and grandmother Valerie Graves, who was killed in a horrific attack just days after Christmas while housesitting a million-pound property

programme.title: The Eighties
programme.desc: [AD] A look at how a mysterious and lethal illness known as Aids developed into a pandemic with enormous political and cultural consequences

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Back in Santa Ana, the buyers face 10 vaults belonging to the same owner. Dave snaps up almost half of them, while Ivy draws a nice profit out of his. But in the end, Mary and Kenny end up doing all the heavy lifting

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: In Stanton, California, Dave learns that making a profit is sometimes like pulling teeth, Mary grinds to get into the black, while Ivy's locker ends up sucking and blowing

programme.title: Great Blue Wild
programme.desc: The creatures to be found in Mexico's Socorro Islands, including Pacific manta rays, hammerhead schools, dolphins and tiger sharks

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: A look at how nickel is mined, how the lock gates for canals are built so that barges and boats can climb hills, and the processes involved in creating Taiwan's beloved bubble tea

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How skyline logging sources Vancouver's most elusive trees. Plus, how ordinary clay is transformed into intricate tiles in a Spanish workshop

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: Teenage brothers with a history of delinquency at school are accused of burglarizing a neighbor's home

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: After a night of underage drinking, teenage best friends dispute who is responsible for wrecking a Ford Focus

programme.title: Impractical Jokers
programme.desc: Hidden camera practical joke show featuring the escapades of Joe, Sal, Murr and Q from comedy troupe the Tenderloins

programme.title: Impractical Jokers
programme.desc: One Joker attempts to woo women with lines provided by the others. The loser has to participate in a seance with Kesha while being given electric shocks by the other Jokers.

programme.title: Police Interceptors
programme.desc: [AD] A drug dealer who has been driving dangerously reveals a surprising amount of information when he is pulled over, and friends try to baffle the pursuit team by changing their names. Meanwhile, an officer has a shock in store for a law-breaking driver

programme.title: The Battle for Britain: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: [AD] The wrecks of planes and ships from the Battle of Britain, revealing new details on how British forces were able to repel the possibility of a Nazi invasion

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Rick Edwards hosts the game show in which contestants compete for the chance to win £10,000, with a single 'impossible' answer knocking them out for the day

programme.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
programme.desc: Tense game show where contestants compete for a top prize of one million pounds - they must answer 15 questions correctly and have just four lifelines to help them.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: The Middle
programme.desc: Tired of being forced to accompany Frankie on weekend errands, Brick pleads with her to let him stay at home alone. Mike overhears one of Sue's supposed friends criticising her, and Axl tries to grow a beard

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.sub-title: Money Laundering and a Cascade of Hormones
programme.desc: Missy asks some uncomfortable questions at church, while Meemaw and Georgie go into business together. Comedy, starring Iain Armitage

programme.title: Am Dro!

programme.desc: Hannah uncovers the wild origins of the modern-day rollercoaster and gets the inside story on Thorpe Park's Hyperia

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: [AD] Painting conservator Lucia Scalisi revives a remarkable but badly bent and buckled portrait of Captain William Marshall, who risked his life to rescue over a hundred shipwrecked Irish emigrants left stranded on an iceberg. Brenton West repairs a precious boxing trophy from the 1950s, Will Kirk restores a well-travelled Jamaican trunk - with help from bookbinder Chris Shaw and textiles conservator Rebecca Bissonet - and Kirsten Ramsay faces the ultimate 3D jigsaw as she is handed a plaster bust that shattered to pieces in an accident

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: [AD] Bob and Paul travel to Co Tyrone to fish at Baronscourt Estate, hoping to catch a pike of a lifetime. They have access to two beautiful and secluded loughs, set in over 130 acres of rolling countryside, and the private use of a rowing boat. Pike are wily fish, always hiding in the dark reeds and waiting to ambush their prey, but Bob has a supposedly foolproof method to try

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: [AD] Researchers estimate another billion people will be online within the next five years, with the majority of these newcomers will be from developing nations in southern Asia and Africa.
