programme.title: UEFA Champions League Final Score
programme.desc: 5 Live commentary alongside the Final Score graphics

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: [AD] Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti are joined by South African chef Ash Valenzuela-Heeger, winner of the 2025 Michelin Young Chef Award, who sets the contestants the challenge of making barbecue beef sirloin, served with maitake mushrooms, caramelised roscoff onions and a cafe au lait sauce. The hopefuls then demonstrate their pastry knowledge as they serve up dessert

programme.title: Murder Case: Fire in the Suburbs
programme.sub-title: Fire in the Suburbs - Part Two
programme.desc: [AD] Part two of two. Bex Williams wakes up from her coma and reveals crucial information about the night of the arson attack, but cannot identify who the masked intruder was. With the killer still at large, detectives must look elsewhere for answers and their attention turns to Cameron Logan's older brother Blair, discovering the two had not always seen eye to eye

programme.title: I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here!
programme.desc: Ant and Dec present highlights as celebrities continue to bond with fellow campmates, while pressure grows to win stars and provide food in today's trial challenge

programme.title: Hunting Alice Bell
programme.desc: [AD] As accusations continue to escalate, Fran and the rest of the women find themselves at a crossroads, aware they must trust each other and stand together or crumble from within. But it isn't easy as Graham Hunter exposes the backgrounds of each woman, leading to further speculation and questions as to who attacked Dr Nash. Mystery thriller, starring Alexandra Roach, Amanda Abbington, Simon Pegg and Ralf Little

programme.title: Surgeons: A Matter of Life or Death
programme.desc: Richard has a massive tumour the size of a billiard ball pressing onto his brain and crushing his motor cortex, which controls movement on Richard's left side. Surgeons must operate otherwise Richard could face a lifetime of paralysis. Phil is preparing for an operation on the rare and potentially aggressive tumour growing from the cartilage of his ribs towards his heart and lungs

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: A former cage fighter enrages a Triad gang, who respond by murdering his family. Seeking redemption, he saves the life of a 12-year-old girl being attacked by gangsters, only to learn she is a mathematical genius in possession of a valuable code - which several criminal factions will kill to get their hands on. Action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Catherine Chan

programme.title: CIA
programme.desc: [AD] When a known smuggler is flagged at the New York border with unidentified cargo, Colin and Bill head upstate to track the suspect and enlist the help of a foreign intelligence officer looking to defect

programme.title: War
programme.desc: [AD] The firms' talks collapse in the wake of an explosive news story, while Johnny's attempt to find a way out of his mess leads him to a surprising escape route. Carla gains ground in court after shifting strategy, leading Cathcarts & Sons to pull out all the stops, while Nicholas and Serena see the end of their firm in sight

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: [AD] The team investigates a survivalist commune when one of its members is poisoned inside a locked bunker. However, with CCTV footage showing that no one went in or came out while he was in there, it seems likely that he has taken his own life - or has he? Meanwhile, Neville has a series of adventurous dates with Sophie. Robert Webb guest stars

programme.title: The Fast Show
programme.desc: [AD] The Off-Roaders go white-water rafting and Channel 9 offer their version of fairy tale The Singing Tree. Comedy sketch show, featuring Paul Whitehouse and Charlie Higson

programme.title: Blackadder II
programme.desc: [AD] Edmund Blackadder, conniving courtier to Elizabeth I, takes in a spirited lad as his manservant - unaware the fellow is actually a woman out to make her fortune. Classic comedy, starring Rowan Atkinson, Miranda Richardson and Stephen Fry, with a guest appearance by Rik Mayall as Edmund's best friend Lord Flashheart. Originally broadcast in 1986

programme.title: QI XL
programme.desc: Extended edition. Question master Stephen Fry continues the comedy panel quiz's exploration of subjects beginning with the letter L as he asks a range of fiendish questions about literature and language. Stand-up comedian Lloyd Langford joins Bad Education star Jack Whitehall, Only Connect host Victoria Coren Mitchell and regular panellist Alan Davies

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough detective is forced to pose as a preschool teacher in a bid to capture a drug dealer whose son is one of the pupils. However, his biggest challenge turns out to be controlling a class full of five-year-olds. Comedy, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Penelope Ann Miller, Linda Hunt, Pamela Reed and Richard Tyson

programme.title: Frank Skinner: 30 Years of Dirt
programme.desc: A show recorded at the Soho Theatre Walthamstow in which the comedian looks back at his career, including his attempts to perform clean comedy and his reflections on growing older

programme.title: Black Widow
programme.desc: [AD] As Lee Wyatt recognises that he is a victim of his wife's coercive control, police believe he could be the key to solving the mystery of Julian Webb's death

programme.title: The Traitors Ireland
programme.desc: Siobhan McSweeney makes a revelation at the mission that leaves the faithful reeling, while the traitors continue to get away with murder

programme.title: The Traitors Ireland
programme.desc: The traitors have to choose who they can trust with a powerful weapon. The faithful are getting desperate and need to turn things around at the round table

programme.title: Dickens on Film - Arena
programme.desc: [AD] From the magical films of the silent era to the celebrated work of director David Lean and high-definition TV, the works of Charles Dickens have inspired countless adaptations. Arena plunders the archives to reveal why the writer's work translates so well onto the screen, going beyond the stories, themes and characters to look at Dickens' prose style, which film-maker Sergei Eisenstein claimed to be already cinematic in its scope, with its rapid cutting between scenes and seamless mixture of the bizarrely comic and terrifyingly profound

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: [AD] Meg goes on a Valentine's Day date with a guy she met online. Lois and Peter spend the day lazing in bed, Brian is visited by all of his former girlfriends and Quagmire is transformed into a beautiful woman

programme.title: Family Guy
programme.desc: [AD] Chris gets teased at school for his budget-brand trainers, and asks for money to help bring his image up to scratch - but is turned down. He attempts to steal from his parents, but is forced into a blackmail pact when Meg confronts him and threatens to report his thieving antics. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian become obsessed with singer Anne Murray

programme.title: Killer Elite
programme.desc: A former secret agent comes out of retirement when his mentor is captured by an Arab leader. The hostage will be freed if the ex-spy kills three fellow operatives in punishment for murders they committed. However, a shadowy society of assassins intends to protect his targets and keep their past crimes a secret. Action thriller, with Jason Statham, Clive Owen and Robert De Niro

programme.title: Decoding Turner
programme.desc: [AD] An analysis of the life and work of JMW Turner as two enthusiasts are joined by art historians and academics to reveal the hidden codes they believe are woven into his paintings

programme.title: Curse of Skinwalker Ranch
programme.desc: With their most compelling findings under scrutiny, the team looks ahead to its boldest investigation yet in the search for answers

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests
programme.desc: Exploring the planet's most diverse woodlands and learning how the forests connect and nurture the lives of countless species

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programme.desc: Mike and Elvis take a huge risk buying a neglected Audi RS2 that they can't test drive. Will this high-performance estate car turn into a €40k money pit?

programme.title: Tattoo Fixers
programme.desc: Trendsetter James needs some landscaping done over his stickman, Joanne desperately requires an inking to stop her getting spanked, and Nicole wants her laddish tatt to be given a girly makeover. George needs some help before he gets detention, John has a Turkish holiday delight taken care of, and Reece is desperate for a distraction

programme.title: Russell Howard: Wonderbox
programme.desc: Russell performs his usual brand of social commentary and discusses some of the joy to be found in everyday experiences. Recorded in front of his home crowd in Bristol

programme.title: Battle: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The Earth is bombarded by what appear to be meteors, but turn out to be the vanguard of an alien invasion force. As America's west coast comes under heavy attack, a platoon of soldiers is sent in to fight off the aliens and rescue civilians - but the troops have only a few hours to complete their mission before the area is bombed. Sci-fi thriller, with Aaron Eckhart and Ramon Rodriguez

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: A secret tunnel and forgotten temple gives an ex-lawyer a lead on the whereabouts of Queen Cleopatra's tomb. Experts dive for the lost city of Alexandria

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh presents as four contestants pit their wits against ruthless quiz genius the Chaser in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught

programme.title: Beat the Chasers
programme.desc: [AD] The Beast, The Governess, The Vixen, The Sinnerman, The Dark Destroyer and The Menace... they're the greatest quiz team that ever lived, but can anyone Beat the Chasers? Bradley Walsh hosts as we find out.

programme.title: Inside the Ambulance
programme.desc: [AD] The blue lights are flashing as crews attend a cycling accident and a man having a suspected stroke. The paramedics assist a woman who has fallen and a baby with multiple seizures

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: 43-year-old Tina lost her nose to cancer. At first, she struggled with how she looked but has now embraced her appearance and aims to inspire others.

programme.title: Chwedl Jan Morris
programme.desc: Concluding the two-part profile of the world-famous author Jan Morris, by her son Twm Morys

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: [AD] The armchair critics share their opinions on shows including The Apprentice, Hunted, Coronation Street, The Underdog: Josh Must Win, Anton & Giovanni's Adventures in Spain and Bridge of Lies. Plus, they reflect on news coverage of the Princess of Wales' cancer diagnosis

programme.title: Warplane Workshop
programme.desc: [AD] Engineers battle to restore Europe's last flying Supermarine Seafire, a rare sea-going version of the original Spitfire

programme.title: Griff Across the Alps
programme.desc: [AD] Griff Rhys Jones' visit to Austria starts deep inside the cave known as the Mouth of Hell. He tends sheep on an eco homestay, and finds himself precariously dangling from mountains as he takes on one of the Alps' most unusual jobs. He also finds time to cook with an elite athlete high in the hills of Werfen and to visit Mozart's birthplace

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, as Sean Lock and David Mitchell take on Jon Richardson and Sara Pascoe. Lexicographer Susie Dent is joined by Ellie White and Natasia Demetriou in Dictionary Corner, while maths whizz Rachel Riley looks after the numbers

programme.title: Gilgo Beach Serial Murders
programme.desc: Looking back at the decades-long investigation revolving around a series of tragic killings between 1996 and 2011 around Gilgo Beach on New York's Long Island

programme.title: Celebrity Yorkshire Auction House
programme.desc: Footballer Peter Shilton and actor Ricky Groves trust Angus to sell treasures for charity. They include goalie gloves and James Bond car parts.

programme.title: Law & Order: Organized Crime
programme.desc: In the explosive season finale, Wheatley goes to court to face his charges while Richie tries to save himself

programme.title: Long Lost Family: What Happened Next

programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Rick Edwards hosts the game show in which 24 recurring contestants compete for the chance to win £10,000, with a single 'impossible' answer knocking them out for the day

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Family members Sarah, Paul, Curtis and Jessica compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Colin Murray and Edith Bowman discover tips and treats at the food and music festival in Newcastle. They find out how to create award-winning burgers and reveal the secrets of chips, French-Canadian style. Briony-May Williams goes on the trail of the nation's favourite herb and chef Julie Lin sets sail to find Scotland's most valuable fish. Farmer Meinir Howells investigates the growing popularity of keeping chickens

programme.title: MOTD: UEFA Champions League
programme.desc: Action from the matchday five fixtures, including Club Brugge v Liverpool at Jan Breydel Stadium, Sporting Lisbon v Manchester United at Estádio José Alvalade and Arsenal v Borussia Dortmund at Emirates Stadium. Liverpool were looking to bounce back from a shock defeat at the hands of Fenerbahce in matchday four, while United will have wanted to build on a comeback against AS Roma, and Arsenal aimed to maintain their unbeaten record in this season's competition

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Alistair Appleton helps a couple who have never lived in an older home, but who are now ready to fall for a bit of period charm in either Norfolk or Suffolk. With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.sub-title: Midlands - A Celestial Projector Is Brought Back to Life
programme.desc: [AD] Dominic Chinea and Mark Stuckey are in the Black Country, tackling the needs of a big red bus. After being used as a mobile shelter by a homelessness charity for a few years, a leaking roof and outdated electrics have combined to keep it off the road. It's a huge fix to take on, in every sense, and the team needs all the help vintage vehicle restorer Mark Owen can provide if they're to get it back into service. Plus, Pauline presents a celestial projector, once owned by her husband. Now the light has stopped working, and many of the constellations have worn away

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: [AD] Michael Portillo travels the length of the Northumbrian coastline, with its glorious beaches and grandiose castles. In the village of Alnmouth he takes to the waves in a traditional skiff built by members of the Alnmouth Coastal Rowing Club. His last stop of the day is the mighty Bamburgh Castle

programme.title: Liz Bonnin's Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: [AD] Liz explores the volcanic islands of the Lesser Antilles, joining residents of Mayreau who are repairing their island's vibrant coral that has been damaged by disease. On neighbouring Union Island, Liz goes on patrol with an environmental army protecting the Union Island gecko, one of the smallest reptiles in the world and which was once one of the most trafficked reptiles in the Caribbean

programme.title: Lingo
programme.desc: Hemel Hempstead husband and wife Hari and Rasika, Merseyside couple Kellie and Eric, and Northern Irish father and son Tony and Laurence use their powers of deduction to work out words that appear in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords. The last remaining duo have the opportunity to win the money they've banked earlier in the show to potentially double their winnings, or leaving with nothing. Adil Ray hosts

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Danni Menzies pulls out all the stops to find Karen and Jerry their dream holiday home on the beautiful Greek island of Corfu, where they can spend lots of time with their children and five grandchildren. They've holidayed in this part of the world many times and have decided now's the right time to buy their very own property. They have a maximum budget of £80,000, but can Danni hit the spot with any of the five fantastic properties she has lined up?

programme.title: Take a Chance at Christmas
programme.desc: When single mum Sutton spends Christmas working, she is persuaded by her son to try a dating app. She meets Mateo, whose arrival could spark romance - and a career-changing opportunity. Romantic drama, starring Alli Chung and Michael Brown

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: [AD] Newly promoted SWAT leader Daniel 'Hondo' Harrelson has to deal with the aftermath of the accidental shooting of a black teenager by a white police officer. Pilot episode of the crime drama based on the 1970s TV series, starring Shemar Moore

programme.title: Caught on Dashcam
programme.desc: Fly-on-the-dashboard documentary showcasing outrageous road disasters, captured in video form by drivers' in-vehicle dashboard cameras

programme.title: Billions
programme.desc: [AD] Axe loses hundreds of millions of dollars on a bad trade and turns to Wendy for help. Meanwhile, Chuck looks to secure some powerful allies. Drama, starring Paul Giamatti

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: Murdoch must prove Brackenreid's innocence when he's framed for murder by a vengeful foe

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.sub-title: How to Go on Holiday without Really Trying
programme.desc: Hyacinth makes expensive vacation plans and discovers that voluntary church cleaning is certainly no holiday. Meanwhile, Rose ends up in a compromising position. Comedy, starring Patricia Routledge and Mary Millar

programme.title: Last of the Summer Wine
programme.desc: Foggy persuades Clegg and Compo that starting a dog-walking business will be no work at all since they are already going on daily countryside rambles. However, the experience proves to be more of a workout than the trio envisage. Brian Wilde, Peter Sallis and Bill Owen star

programme.title: Speed with Guy Martin
programme.desc: The motorcycle racer heads to Colorado where he hopes to win one of America's oldest races - the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb. In this annual contest, known as the Race to the Clouds, riders compete against the clock on a gruelling mountainside track that finishes more than 13,000ft above sea level. To learn the skills required in hill-climb events, Guy visits the birthplace of the sport - Shelsley Walsh in Worcestershire. Racing up the course in an F1-style car, he realises sheer horsepower and driving precision are vital, but he must also take a high-altitude fitness test in a hypoxic chamber to prepare for the challenge ahead

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with the Late Thanksgiving
programme.desc: [AD] Monica reluctantly agrees to cook Thanksgiving dinner, but the others all turn up late, so she and Chandler angrily lock them out - until an unexpected phone call changes their mood completely

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The One with the Birth Mother
programme.desc: [AD] Monica and Chandler travel to Ohio to meet the mother of the baby they plan to adopt. The pregnant mother, Erica, likes them but only because their files got mixed up with a doctor and a female minister. Meanwhile, Joey is set up on a date with one of Phoebe's friends, but soon regrets it when she tries to take some food off his plate, and Ross has a fashion faux pas when he accidently wears women's clothing on a date

programme.title: Will & Grace
programme.desc: [AD] Jack's new act fails to impress Will, and Grace decides to split up with Ben - then changes her mind. American comedy, starring Eric McCormack, Sean Hayes and Debra Messing

programme.title: Will & Grace
programme.desc: [AD] Will tries to set Jack up with a customer at a clothes shop, while Grace's ex-boyfriend makes a tempting offer. Jeremy Piven and Patrick Dempsey guest star

programme.title: The Only Way Is Essex
programme.desc: A rift tears through Girl Band, and everyone's loyalty is called into question. Amy confronts Harry and Wills, and Ella and Dani partake in some scream therapy.

programme.title: Classic Emmerdale
programme.desc: [AD] Brenda is shocked to learn Terry knows about her bankruptcy, Nicola goes into labour while locked up alone in the Home Farm shop, and Val tries to win back Pollard.

programme.title: The Prisoner
programme.desc: Number Six becomes a pawn in a human game of chess while trying to recruit an army of like-minded souls - and learns to judge the Villagers' allegiances by their moves. Cult drama, starring Patrick McGoohan

programme.title: Killer in My Village
programme.desc: The story of 15-year-old Kayleigh Haywood from Leicestershire, who was groomed by a man she met online before being lured to her death in 2015

programme.title: The Eighties
programme.desc: [AD] A look at America's economic growth throughout the 1980s, a decade of junk bonds, savings and loan bailouts and pervasive Wall Street corruption

programme.title: Storage Wars

Director Paul Feig's romantic comedy, starring Emilia Clarke, Henry Golding, Michelle Yeoh and Emma Thompson, who also co-wrote the script

Superhero adventure, starring Tom Holland, Michael Keaton and Robert Downey Jr

Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Shameik Moore and Nicolas Cage

programme.desc: [AD] A Victorian widower struggles to control his seven unruly children, who have already driven a series of childminders to distraction. Period fantasy adventure, starring Emma Thompson, Colin Firth and Kelly Macdonald

programme.sub-title: Nanny McPhee and the Big Bang

Fantasy comedy, with Emma Thompson, Maggie Gyllenhaal and Sam Kelly

programme.title: Hook

Steven Spielberg's fantasy adventure, with Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman, Julia Roberts, Bob Hoskins and Maggie Smith

Remake of the 1950s comedy, with Steve Martin, Diane Keaton, Kimberly Williams and Martin Short

Sci-fi adventure, with Jeff Bridges and Garrett Hedlund

Gothic horror, starring James McAvoy and Daniel Radcliffe

Action thriller sequel to Olympus Has Fallen, starring Gerard Butler, Aaron Eckhart and Morgan Freeman

Action adventure sequel, starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard

Comedy, with Jim Carrey, Maura Tierney, Justin Cooper, Jennifer Tilly and Cary Elwes

Family comedy, starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Eric Idle, Cathy Moriarty and featuring the voice of Malachi Pearson

Black comedy based on the 1960s TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia, Christopher Lloyd, Christina Ricci, Jimmy Workman and Carel Struycken

Comedy, starring Steve Guttenberg, Kim Cattrall, Bubba Smith and GW Bailey

Guy Ritchie's comedy drama, with Jason Statham, Brad Pitt, Benicio Del Toro and Stephen Graham

Thriller from director Paul Verhoeven, starring Sharon Stone, Michael Douglas, George Dzundza and Jeanne Tripplehorn

programme.desc: A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel

programme.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
programme.sub-title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
programme.desc: An eccentric marine expert sets out in search of a legendary shark that ate his old friend and shipmate. Unfortunately the voyage is riddled with problems, including a man claiming to be his long-lost son, a pursuing pirate crew and a rival oceanographer. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Willem Dafoe and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: The caped crusader and his sidekick take on the villainous Mr Freeze, who plans to destroy Gotham City with an icy doomsday weapon unless his demands are met. The dynamic duo also have to contend with femme fatale Poison Ivy, who is determined to drive a wedge between them. Comic-book adventure, starring George Clooney, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John Rambo is wrongfully arrested in a backwoods town and tested to the limits of his endurance by a brutal deputy. Rambo escapes from his cell and heads out to the woods, and with the forces of the law in hot pursuit he finally has the chance to fight them on his own terms. Action thriller, starring Sylvester Stallone, Brian Dennehy, Richard Crenna and David Caruso

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: [AD] An immature 32-year-old is heartbroken when his girlfriend walks out on him. In a plan to win her back, he volunteers to look after his flatmate's five-year-old son, thus demonstrating he is finally ready to grow up. However, his ideas of childcare prove unconventional and chaos quickly ensues. Comedy, with Adam Sandler, Joey Lauren Adams, Jon Stewart, Josh Mostel, Leslie Mann, Rob Schneider and Kristy Swanson, alongside Steve Buscemi in a cameo role

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: [AD] A tough detective is forced to pose as a preschool teacher in a bid to capture a drug dealer whose son is one of the pupils. However, his biggest challenge turns out to be controlling a class full of five-year-olds. Comedy, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Penelope Ann Miller, Linda Hunt, Pamela Reed and Richard Tyson

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Facing closure from cutbacks in public spending and competition from a more successful academy, the police training school calls on its bungling graduates to act as instructors and make good officers out of a bunch of new recruits even more incompetent than they are. Comedy sequel, starring Steve Guttenberg, Bubba Smith, Michael Winslow and Art Metrano

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: A vet working at a Hawaiian zoo falls madly in love with a beautiful woman and pulls out all the stops to romance her. However, his attempts to woo her are seriously undermined by the fact that she suffers from short-term memory loss, meaning he has to resume his courtship from scratch every day. Romantic comedy, starring Drew Barrymore, Adam Sandler, Rob Schneider and Dan Aykroyd

programme.title: Shaft
programme.desc: A maverick detective vows to catch a racist criminal suspected of murdering an innocent black man. However, the only witness is reluctant to talk, and the killer comes from a very wealthy family, prompting the tough-talking cop to quit the force and bring in the culprit on his own terms. Remake of the blaxploitation thriller, starring Samuel L Jackson, Christian Bale and Toni Collette

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: [AD] Autistic number-cruncher Christian Wolff moonlights as a money launderer for the Mob. However, the Treasury Department start closing in on him, so he decides to take on a legitimate client in the form of a robotics company. As he works through their books, he uncovers a discrepancy involving millions of dollars. Action-packed thriller, starring Ben Affleck, Anna Kendrick and JK Simmons

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: [AD] When a couple flee Europe in 1947, their new lives in the US are changed by a strange client. Director Brady Corbet's drama, starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones, Guy Pearce and Joe Alwyn

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Three former opera singers prepare for their annual concert to mark Verdi's birthday and raise funds for their retirement home. However, this year, a famous diva has joined the group, and her history with the others threatens the performance. Comedy drama, directed by Dustin Hoffman and starring Maggie Smith, Billy Connolly, Tom Courtenay, Pauline Collins and Michael Gambon

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: [AD] Four decades ago, Michael Myers terrorised the town of Haddonfield, Illinois and went on a killing spree, 15 years after murdering his sister. After a prison bus crashes, the killer is back in the wild, but survivor Laurie Strode is ready for his return. Director David Gordon Green's horror sequel based on John Carpenter's much imitated 1978 namesake movie, starring Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer and Andi Matichak

programme.title: All I Need for Christmas
programme.desc: A singer-songwriter struggling to cope with changes in the industry and an entrepreneur in need of some time alone bond while looking for a break from the pressures of their lives by spending Christmas in the country. Romantic drama, starring Mallory Jansen and Dan Jeannotte

programme.title: Santa Tell Me
programme.desc: [AD] A designer receives a message from Santa saying she will meet the love of her life by Christmas, and that his name will be Nick. However, this just causes confusion when she meets three men named Nick in rapid succession, while also finding herself attracted to a co-worker called Chris. Romantic drama, starring Erin Krakow and Daniel Lissing

programme.title: Zola
programme.desc: A Detroit waitress strikes up a new friendship with a customer, who persuades her to join a weekend of dancing and partying in Florida. What at first seems like a glamorous trip rapidly transforms into a 48-hour journey involving a pimp, local gangsters and other unexpected adventures. Crime comedy drama, starring Taylour Paige and Riley Keough

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: [AD] Seventeen-year-old Millie Kessler spends her days trying to survive high school and the cruel actions of the popular crowd. But when she becomes the latest target of the Butcher, the town's infamous serial killer, her senior year becomes the least of her worries. When the Butcher's mystical dagger causes him and Millie to magically switch bodies, the frightened teen learns she has just 24 hours to get her identity back before she looks like a middle-aged maniac for ever. Comedy horror, starring Vince Vaughn and Kathryn Newton

British thriller, starring Brian Cox, Damian Lewis and Joseph Fiennes
